response.original_title: [{Upgrade→Help}] How to upgrade Qantas flight to Premium Economy?
response.overview: To upgrade to Qantas Premium Economy ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK), you can either redeem Qantas Points (Classic Upgrade Reward) or use cash/cash + points (Bid Now Upgrade). You can request your upgrade online via the Qantas Manage ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) Booking portal or directly through the Qantas App.
